A Document With Everything
Mixed features in one file, as real documents are
Introduction
This document mixes bold, italic, a link, and a footnote in one paragraph. Sublime converts files. This paragraph exists so that the paragraph has more than one line when laid out on a page, which matters for line spacing, indents, and column tests. It says nothing else of interest.
